name: Francesca Maty
original_name: フランチェスカ・マティ
source:
Another friend of Marie's, she's a wealthy woman with extravagant sexual tastes, which she explores alongside Yukari. A foreigner, she has an affinity for using male sperm as a way of preserving her youthful appearance. [spoiler]In the past, she accidentally killed one of Yukari's servants after over injecting sexual stimulant.[/spoiler]
